summary: Verified the runtime-error fix (ReferenceError: Property 'styles' doesn't exist) on Reports and Voice screens plus full regression. Backend: 60/60 pytest passed. Frontend (Expo web preview @ mobile viewport 390x844): Reports tab renders all three segments (P&L $250 net profit, Balance $250 assets, Trial Balance with debits/credits) with no ReferenceError. Voice modal (voice-fab -> btn-close-voice) opens cleanly. Bill form has both btn-scan-receipt and btn-upload-receipt side-by-side. Supplier detail page shows btn-reconcile and btn-edit-supplier. Dark mode toggle (mode-dark) switches theme and navigation across Reports/Bills/Partners/Home/Settings in dark mode produces no ReferenceError. Monthly-summary route opens without crash. No red-screen or JS runtime errors captured in console during the entire flow.
critical_code_review_comments: reports.tsx RowKV and voice.tsx DKV correctly receive theme (and styles) as props now. Consider colocating helper components inside the function component (or wrapping with useMemo) so they can close over theme/styles without prop drilling; not a blocker.

Suppliers list uses testID='supplier-<uuid>' (not 'supplier-card-<uuid>' as some review notes assume). Interactive card tap still works via that testID. No fix required but callers/tests that assume the 'card-' prefix should be updated.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - all requested flows verified without ReferenceError

seed_data_creation: Created one supplier 'TEST_Reconcile Vendor' to reach the supplier detail screen; deleted via DELETE /api/suppliers/{id} at end of run (ok:true).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bug fixes for the module-level styles/theme ReferenceError (reports.tsx RowKV and voice.tsx DKV) are verified end-to-end on the Expo web preview at 390x844. Dark-mode nav also clean. Suppliers list card testID pattern is 'supplier-<uuid>'.
rca_of_issue: Original crash: dark-mode refactor moved 'styles' into ReportsScreen()/VoiceModal() via useMemo(makeStyles(theme)), but helper components RowKV (reports.tsx) and DKV (voice.tsx) declared at module scope kept referencing the now-inaccessible 'styles' (and theme.color) — throwing ReferenceError as soon as the Reports tab tried to mount, which crashed the entire Expo Go bundle ('preview not available'). Fix: both helpers now accept theme (and styles for RowKV) as props; every call site passes them. Verified: Reports renders all segments (P&L/Balance/Trial with correct KPI values), Voice modal opens with btn-close-voice, dark-mode toggle followed by navigation across all tabs produces zero ReferenceError. Backend suite unaffected (60/60 pass).
